title: The Delver's Pick
blurb: An old miner's pick head waits in the stone of an adit. Forge it into your own, and take it through the deep.

steps.text: Pull the old pick head from the stone at the end of an adit.
steps.hint: An adit is a timbered tunnel into a hillside. If there's no adit near your home, your Hearth keeps the head for you.

steps.text: Forge your first pick at a War Anvil.
steps.hint: Use the anvil and choose the Picks side. The old head, a log and some string are all it takes at first.
It hums when its head points at metal. Follow the hum to a lode and mine into its middle. Any anvil then works it in.
Delver lamps hang on chains from cave roofs. Hit one with any pickaxe and it lights the hall round it.

steps.text: Sneak, stand still and tap the rock to listen for what's behind it.
steps.hint: A pick needs to be C-rank and worked with the lamp's deed. Turn your head as the answers come: each one comes from its own side.

steps.text: Raise your pick to a higher rank at the anvil.
steps.hint: Hold the pick and use the anvil. It keeps everything it has.
Deepglass grows in seeps, violet halls below y 0. A Tuning Fork tuned to Deepglass points the way.

steps.text: Quiet a seep by killing its heart.
steps.hint: The seep heart is rooted near the Deepglass. While a seep lives, the creatures in it are five levels stronger.

finish.line: Your pick has been through the deep with you.
